issues.description: Missing import for 're' module causes NameError at runtime, crashing the evaluator on both golden and baseline runs.
issues.evidence: Traceback: NameError: name 're' is not defined in extract_signal_names at line 29.

issues.description: Evaluator crashes before emitting PASS/FAIL for FR3, FR4, SR1, SR2, so the golden solution is rejected and the baseline is not properly graded.
issues.evidence: Golden run stdout shows only FR1 and FR2 PASS, then a traceback; no further requirement markers.

issues.description: Targeting mutants exist but were never executed because the evaluator crashes before mutation testing can run, leaving all requirements untested.
issues.evidence: Validation report shows mutation_score=0.0 and all requirements listed as untested.

issues.description: The evaluator does not handle the case where extract_signal_names fails; it should catch exceptions and emit a clear FAIL for FR3 instead of crashing.
issues.evidence: No try/except around the call to extract_signal_names.

issues.description: README mentions iverilog/vvp availability but the evaluator never uses them; this is misleading but not a correctness issue.
issues.evidence: README states 'The toolchain (iverilog, vvp) is available for optional cross-checks' but evaluate.py contains no subprocess calls.

recommendations: Add 'import re' at the top of evaluation/private/ground_truth.py.
Wrap the call to extract_signal_names in a try/except inside evaluate.py so that a failure in signal extraction produces a clear [TEST] FAIL: FR3 instead of a crash.
Re-run the validation pipeline after fixing the import to confirm that the golden solution passes all requirements and the baseline fails appropriately.
Ensure that mutation testing is executed after the evaluator is fixed to verify discrimination of each requirement.
Remove or clarify the mention of iverilog/vvp in the README if the evaluator does not actually use them.

requirement_results.evidence: Evaluator crashes before completing grading; FR1 was marked PASS on golden run but overall verdict is invalid due to crash.
Evaluator crashes before completing grading; FR2 was marked PASS on golden run but overall verdict is invalid due to crash.
